command.description: 2026-10-05 ET (code-review fixes F1-F3, C10): the certify command that made the record. Records before 2026-10-05 carry only version and sources_sha256 (plus kind, profile, seed and isolation for library operations); swdb.certification_procedures.classify maps them to their procedure.

version.description: The command version label within its family (candidate 1.3-1.6, native 1.3-1.5, library operation 1.0-1.2, lowering and calibration 1.1).

family.description: The command family whose version table the label belongs to (new records).

library_operation_version.description: Library-operation records only: the library-operation command version, so it is never read as a candidate version.

sources_sha256.description: Digest of the files the command reads. From 2026-10-05: of the per-version manifest in sources; before: of every certification module and library certification folder.

sources.description: The per-version source manifest: each file the version reads, plus its procedure definition row.

kernel_sources.description: The kernel plug-in and its result check (recorded, not part of the version's identity).

sources_match_version.description: True when sources_sha256 equals the digest the version table froze for this version.

code.description: The git commit of the checkout that ran, and whether the version's files differ from it.

evidence_basis.description: ADR 0008 (2026-10-05 ET): simulated for runs on the DX100 functional model (candidate artifacts of DX100 contracts, lowerings, calibration); measured for runs of real code on the host CPU (native-CPU contracts, library operations). Records before 2026-10-05 say simulated on every path.

clause_controls.description: 2026-10-04 ET: per contract clause, its negative control compared with the check the clause names.

source.description: 2026-10-04 ET (ticket 68): certifier rows enforce knob_range and schedule_range through the certifier's own controls.

reason.description: Why a row is not enforceable (ticket 68).

profile.description: 2026-10-05 ET (ticket 75): the native candidate profile a native-CPU contract pins (id, path, sha256, target, target_scope; under certify 1.4 and 1.5 also the random run schedule), for native command versions 1.3, 1.4 and 1.5.
